ranked_failure_mechanisms: Primary measured: full-stack rule has negative expectancy after costs (WR shortfall vs R-payoff BE; PF 0.72; mean_net_r < 0) across 670 trades—not chart-selected.
Engine concentration: TREND_LONG is the main economic drain (n=194, PF 0.379, mean_net_r -0.238); other engines near-flat or tiny-n/chronology-distorted.
Entry-location / zero-runway selection: large loser share never reach +0.25R (43.3%); breakout-long median loser is extended release entry that dies in ~5 minutes.

Same-bar multi-indicator confirmation without temporal arming/expiry: code property that allows strongly agreed states to enter already-extended or counter-structure locations; indicators describe regime more than forward edge.

Secondary: fixed SL/1.5R/max-hold path leaves many +0.5R-then-loss outcomes; money-mode risk collapse makes later USD wins unable to repair early large-R losses; rare stop-gap/slippage tails (extreme loss) add execution residual under Model-0.

bottom_line: ACCEPT WITH CHANGES: terminal no-edge is fully supported by the 670-trade population (and engine/path/risk tables), not by the seven anatomy charts. Charts and CSV agree and illustrate non-ranking confirmation, counter-structure range losses, and one stop-gap tail; they must not authorize filters. Soften the causal leap from same-bar stack to *the* failure reason, and treat QQE Cell15→16 PF drop as non-rescue evidence rather than clean harm proof. Legal next work is at most the preregistered sequence and path ablations (plus a true fresh mechanism if needed)—no post-hoc threshold or pocket rescue.
